about: Organizer-style set: the organizer samples (X, sources/2026-11-21-czy-we-wloszech-strajk-generalny.docx) with style checks, and variants on other topics (R) using real fact-checks found in the Google Fact Check index on 2026-11-21. Used ONLY by eval/run.ts (deno task eval:organizer), never in prompts or code (rule 16). Gold labels by the agent; a human should review them (evaluation/benchmark.md). Fact-check ratings can change and the index can drop items: re-check a failing R case in Fact Check Explorer before blaming the pipeline.
